title: Shapes around us

parent.learn: Circle: round, no corners, no straight sides.
parent.why: Every point on a circle's edge is the same distance from the middle. That is why wheels are circles — they roll smoothly.
“Tri” means three. Count the sides with a finger to check.

parent.learn: Square: 4 sides, all the same length. Rectangle: 4 sides, opposite sides the same.
parent.why: Both have 4 corners. A square is a rectangle whose sides are all equal — like a stretched square becomes a rectangle.

parent.learn: Find shapes in real things: clock (circle), door (rectangle), pizza slice (triangle).
parent.why: Shapes are not just drawings; spotting them at home makes the idea stick.

parent.learn: Some solid things roll, some slide.
parent.why: A ball has a curved surface, so it rolls. A box has flat faces, so it slides. Flat faces sit still; curved ones roll.

ask: Find something round in this room.
Find something shaped like a rectangle.
Draw a triangle. How many corners does it have?
Which of these rolls: a ball or a book? Try it!
What shape is a roti? A chapati box?
Count the corners of this book.

rounds.h: A circle is round all the way, with no corners.
A triangle has 3 sides and 3 corners.
A square has 4 equal sides and 4 corners.
A star has pointy tips all around.

rounds.t: Which one is round like a circle?
rounds.h: A round biscuit has no corners — like a circle.

rounds.t: How many corners does a triangle have?
How many sides does a square have?
rounds.h: Top, bottom, left side, right side: 4.

rounds.t: How many corners does a circle have?
rounds.h: A circle is round all the way round. It has no corners at all: 0.

rounds.t: Which is shaped like a triangle?
rounds.h: A slice of pizza has 3 sides, coming to a point.

rounds.t: Which is shaped like a rectangle?
rounds.h: A door has 4 straight sides — two long and two short.
A ball is curved all over, so it rolls.

rounds.t: Which slides but does not roll?
rounds.h: A box has flat faces, so it slides instead of rolling.

rounds.t: The faces of a dice are shaped like…
rounds.h: Each face of a dice has 4 equal sides: a square.

rounds.t: How many sides do 2 triangles have in all?
How many corners does a rectangle have?
rounds.h: A rectangle, like a door, has 4 corners.
